# APIS and Token Creation

**APIS** is the creation-fuel of the MELEK token economy: you obtain it by permanently locking MELEK, and you spend it to **create your own token** and turn on its rewards. It is MELEK-Engine's equivalent of Hive-Engine's "BEE" fee token, named for *Apis*, the sacred bee. This article explains where APIS comes from, what you do with it, and how the token you create reaches the market. It builds on [[Running Tokens on MELEK-Engine]] and [[Hive Engine and Smart Media Tokens]].

== Where APIS Comes From: Locking MELEK ==

APIS is **earned**, not bought from a faucet. The mechanism follows Hive-Engine's WORKERBEE → BEE model, remapped:

# You **forever-lock** MELEK (as the engine's wrapped-MELEK side token). The lock is **permanent** — there is no unstake.
# Locking mints **APIS-Hash**, a soulbound (non-transferable) mining-power balance, 1:1 with what you locked.
# APIS-Hash **mines APIS** on a fixed schedule — a set amount of APIS per day is split across all APIS-Hash holders by share. More lockers only split the same fixed pie; it is not inflationary.

So "post on MELEK to lock MELEK and get APIS" resolves to: lock → earn mining power → mine the spendable APIS you then use to create things. Permanently converting MELEK into creation-power keeps the fuel scarce and earned.

== What You Spend APIS On ==

APIS is **burned** as the fee for the acts of creation on MELEK-Engine:

* '''Create a token''' — burning a fixed amount of APIS registers a brand-new token (you set its symbol, precision, supply, and rules).
* '''Add SCOT''' — burning APIS turns on the token's **social reward pool** ("Smart Contracts On Tokens"): posts tagged for your community earn your token, stake-weighted, on the schedule and author/curator split you choose.
* '''Make a Seed''' — burning APIS makes a token into a Kush-Farm "seed" asset.
* '''Resource fees''' — small APIS burns pay for engine operations beyond the free allowance.

Because creation and rewards cost APIS, and APIS costs locked MELEK, the whole economy is anchored back to MELEK.

== From Your Token to the Market ==

Once your token exists and (optionally) rewards content via SCOT, it can leave the social layer and become **tradable**:

# **Bridge** the token onto the [[PRANA Compute Chain|PRANA]] chain as a wrapped ERC-20.
# **List** it on [[KulaSwap and the DEX Lineage|KulaSwap]] — create the pair, seed liquidity.
# **Trade, provide liquidity, and farm** — your community now has a market and a little DeFi economy around its token.

The full loop: **lock MELEK → earn APIS → create your token → reward your community with SCOT → bridge to KulaSwap → trade and farm.** You can enter at any point.
